packageRules.description: Keep every workflow action SHA-pinned; Renovate updates the digest and the version comment together
Weekly batch: Python non-major (api/gateway/mandate locks regenerate via the uv pip compile header)
cpex-ocsf-audit holds base64 at 0.22: praxis-proxy/policy is on 0.22 (jsonwebtoken 11 requires it) and the crate is copied into that tree; see the comment in its Cargo.toml
Digest and pin updates automerge once every check is green (platformAutomerge is off, so Renovate merges on its own run and waits for all checks, not only the required ones)

praxis-policy-core digest bumps never automerge: the pin is held deliberately (#536) and the lockfile needs the cpex sibling checkout to regenerate. matchDepNames, not matchPackageNames: for a cargo git dependency Renovate's packageName is the repository URL, and the old rule never matched (#564)
Majors always ride solo and never automerge, so each gets its own review
